description: Source code for Git's bisect functionality, including algorithms for commit selection, reference management, and bisect process control.

methods.name: count_distance
methods.description: Counts the distance of commits for bisect algorithm.

methods.name: clear_distance
methods.description: Resets the COUNTED flag on commits.

methods.name: weight
methods.description: Retrieves the weight of a commit in bisect.

methods.name: weight_set
methods.description: Sets the weight of a commit in bisect.

methods.name: count_interesting_parents
methods.description: Counts the number of interesting parent commits.

methods.name: approx_halfway
methods.description: Determines if a commit is approximately halfway in the bisect.

methods.name: show_list
methods.description: Displays a list of commits for debugging.

methods.name: best_bisection

methods.description: Comparator for sorting commits by distance.

methods.name: best_bisection_sorted

methods.description: Performs the core bisect algorithm to find the next commit.

methods.name: find_bisection
methods.description: Main function to find the bisect commit.

methods.description: Registers references for bisect.

methods.name: read_bisect_refs
methods.description: Reads bisect-related refs from repository.

methods.name: read_bisect_paths
methods.description: Reads bisect path files.

methods.description: Joins OID array into a hex string.

methods.description: Filters out skipped commits from list.

methods.description: Manages skipped commits list.
